title: Bitki Bazlı Salçalı Sosis
teaser: Vegan Vosis ürünümüzle hazırlanan, ekmek arası veya ana yemek olarak servis edilebilen pratik bir tarif.
steps: Salçayı su ile açıp tavaya ekleyin, kısık ateşte 5 dakika pişirin.
teaserEn: A quick recipe made with our Vegan Vosis — serve it in bread or as a main dish.
stepsEn: Slice the sausages however you like.
Lightly sauté the garlic in olive oil.
Add the sausages and fry for a few minutes.
Loosen the tomato paste with water, add to the pan and simmer for 5 minutes.
Season with the spices and serve hot.
